scenes.heading: Before interpretation, evidence.
captions: A market headline leaves important questions unanswered.
Sourcebrief preserves the evidence behind the headline.
Inspect, save, compare, and export.

scenes.heading: A market, with its context.
captions: These are genuine Panta responses, replayed locally.
They were captured on October second.
The original time and recorded label remain.
Missing catalogue titles come from retrieved detail.

scenes.heading: Read the rule. Keep its source.
captions: Read the resolution wording beside its sources.
Source identifiers are supplied by the provider.
They are not independently verified links.
Missing or shortened information stays explicitly marked.

scenes.heading: Values retain their meaning.
captions: Price source and status remain visible.
Undocumented raw scales are not guessed.
Zero is a value, not missing information.
Reported and total volume remain separate fields.

scenes.heading: Keep a checkpoint.
captions: Save this observation as a local checkpoint.
It stays attached to this market.
The original capture time travels with it.

scenes.heading: Resume the review.
captions: This capture shows the checkpoint after reload.
Persistence belongs to this browser and origin.
It is not an immutable audit log.

scenes.heading: Compare facts, not request metadata.
captions: Refresh compares supported fields with that checkpoint.
Replaying the same observation changes no facts.
A new request identifier is not change.
Equivalent decimal formatting also remains unchanged.

scenes.heading: Carry the evidence forward.
captions: Export a readable brief or structured JSON.
Both preserve source mode and capture time.

scenes.heading: The original checkpoint travels with the export.
captions: Changed fields retain before and after values.
This is a reviewable handoff, not certification.

scenes.heading: An outcome is not a quote.
captions: This captured record reports a resolved outcome.
Its zero and one values stay intact.
They are not current trading quotes.

scenes.heading: Inspect the evidence.
captions: Independently implemented, with substantial Codex assistance.
Optional live mode uses your own key.
No trading or independent source certification.
External adoption has not yet been measured.
Inspect the code and reproducible evidence.
